summary: newDBMetrics now creates and registers three new metrics for selected-series compaction: a triggered counter, a failed counter and a duration histogram. They are only updated by the new CompactSelectedSeries path, so existing behavior is unchanged apart from three extra exported series. A line-by-line review is not needed beyond checking the names are unique.
headline: Add metrics for selected-series compaction count, failures and duration
reason: Only adds new metric definitions and registration, with names distinct from the existing stale-series metrics; they are used solely by the new compaction path.
